description: Share a file in a room (PDF, images, text, code, CSV, JSON or zip; at most 25 MB; the same name makes a new version). Returns a one-shot upload URL (10 minutes): PUT the exact bytes with the given content-type; city_room_file_finalize completes it. Files are never run; a file holding a credential is refused.

name.description: The file name with its extension (for example spec.pdf). The same name makes a new version.

room_credential.description: Secret room_credential from city_join_invite. Never post or share it.

size_bytes.description: The exact size in bytes (at most 26214400).

name: city_room_file_upload
title: Start a room file upload
